pistol_basic.name: Hand Cannon
pistol_basic.flavor: Loud, heavy, and convinced every problem is just a hole waiting to happen.

sniper_basic.name: Quiet Regret
sniper_basic.flavor: Patience is a virtue. So is a very long barrel.

worm.name: Pink Earthworm
worm.flavor: Small, pink and mildly offended. It wriggles whenever you stare at it.

ak47.name: AK-47
ak47.flavor: Older than most of the skeletons, and a lot more reliable.

m60.name: M60
m60.flavor: Heavy, hungry, and generous with its ammunition. Mostly toward other people.

shotgun_double.name: Double-Barrel Shotgun
shotgun_double.flavor: Two chances to be loud. It takes both of them.

rocket_launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
rocket_launcher.flavor: For when a bullet feels like too polite a suggestion.

grenade_launcher.name: Grenade Launcher
grenade_launcher.flavor: Lobs your problems at somebody else. Gift-wrapping not included.

tin_hat.name: Tin Hat
tin_hat.flavor: Keeps the signals out. The skeletons never had any.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.flavor: Smells like a blacksmith's regret. Fits like it too.

gold_hoops.name: Gold Hoops
gold_hoops.flavor: Shiny enough to distract exactly nobody.

frost_amulet.name: Frost Amulet
frost_amulet.flavor: Cold to the touch and mildly smug about it.

cool_shades.name: Cool Shades
cool_shades.flavor: You cannot be hit if you look this good. Mostly.

cigarette.name: Lit Cigarette
cigarette.flavor: Smoldering with attitude. Left click reloads an empty gun for you.

band_shirt.name: Band Shirt
band_shirt.flavor: Faded from a concert nobody remembers.

iron_gauntlets.name: Iron Gauntlets
iron_gauntlets.flavor: For punching problems back into their coffins.

ember_ring.name: Ember Ring
ember_ring.flavor: Warm to the touch. Do not wear while handling marshmallows.

venom_ring.name: Venom Ring
venom_ring.flavor: Hisses faintly when nobody is listening.

charm_bracelet.name: Charm Bracelet
charm_bracelet.flavor: Each charm is a tiny lucky escape.

iron_greaves.name: Iron Greaves
iron_greaves.flavor: Clanks with every step, so stealth is out.

tattered_cape.name: Tattered Cape
tattered_cape.flavor: Flaps dramatically even with no wind.

leather_belt.name: Leather Belt
leather_belt.flavor: Holds up your trousers and your confidence.

work_boots.name: Work Boots
work_boots.flavor: Steel toes. Old socks. Good vibes.

phoons_treasure.name: Phoon's Treasure
phoons_treasure.flavor: Too much for anyone. Hold jump and never stop: these hop on their own, and your legs never tire.

iron_sabatons.name: Iron Sabatons
iron_sabatons.flavor: Stomps are now a legitimate fighting style.

gun.name: Rolled Gun
gun.flavor: Built from parts. No two are alike.
